scene.label: Act 2, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. Rome. Before the palace

lines.text: Now climbeth Tamora Olympus' top,
lines.plainText: Now climbeth Tamora Olympus' top

lines.text: Safe out of Fortune's shot, and sits aloft,
lines.plainText: Safe out of Fortune's shot and sits aloft

lines.text: Secure of thunder's crack or lightning's flash,
lines.plainText: Secure of thunder's crack or lightning's flash

lines.text: Advanced above pale envy's threat'ning reach.
lines.plainText: Advanced above pale envy's threat'ning reach

lines.text: As when the golden sun salutes the morn,
lines.plainText: As when the golden sun salutes the morn

lines.text: And, having gilt the ocean with his beams,
lines.plainText: And having gilt the ocean with his beams

lines.text: Gallops the zodiac in his glistening coach,
lines.plainText: Gallops the zodiac in his glistening coach

lines.text: And overlooks the highest-peering hills;
lines.plainText: And overlooks the highestpeering hills

lines.text: So Tamora.
lines.plainText: So Tamora

lines.text: Upon her wit doth earthly honour wait,
lines.plainText: Upon her wit doth earthly honour wait

lines.text: And virtue stoops and trembles at her frown.
lines.plainText: And virtue stoops and trembles at her frown

lines.text: Then, Aaron, arm thy heart and fit thy thoughts
lines.plainText: Then Aaron arm thy heart and fit thy thoughts

lines.text: To mount aloft with thy imperial mistress,
lines.plainText: To mount aloft with thy imperial mistress

lines.text: And mount her pitch, whom thou in triumph long
lines.plainText: And mount her pitch whom thou in triumph long

lines.text: Hast prisoner held, fett'red in amorous chains,
lines.plainText: Hast prisoner held fett'red in amorous chains

lines.text: And faster bound to Aaron's charming eyes
lines.plainText: And faster bound to Aaron's charming eyes

lines.text: Than is Prometheus tied to Caucasus.
lines.plainText: Than is Prometheus tied to Caucasus

lines.text: Away with slavish weeds and servile thoughts!
lines.plainText: Away with slavish weeds and servile thoughts

lines.text: I will be bright, and shine in pearl and gold,
lines.plainText: I will be bright and shine in pearl and gold

lines.text: To wait upon this new-made empress.
lines.plainText: To wait upon this newmade empress

lines.text: To wait, said I? To wanton with this queen,
lines.plainText: To wait said I To wanton with this queen

lines.text: This goddess, this Semiramis, this nymph,
lines.plainText: This goddess this Semiramis this nymph

lines.text: This siren, that will charm Rome's Saturnine,
lines.plainText: This siren that will charm Rome's Saturnine

lines.text: And see his shipwrack and his commonweal's.
lines.plainText: And see his shipwrack and his commonweal's

lines.text: Holla! What storm is this?
lines.plainText: Holla What storm is this

lines.text: Chiron, thy years wants wit, thy wit wants edge
lines.plainText: Chiron thy years wants wit thy wit wants edge

lines.text: And manners, to intrude where I am graced,
lines.plainText: And manners to intrude where I am graced

lines.text: And may, for aught thou knowest, affected be.
lines.plainText: And may for aught thou knowest affected be

lines.text: Demetrius, thou dost overween in all,
lines.plainText: Demetrius thou dost overween in all

lines.text: And so in this, to bear me down with braves.
lines.plainText: And so in this to bear me down with braves

lines.text: 'Tis not the difference of a year or two
lines.plainText: 'Tis not the difference of a year or two

lines.text: Makes me less gracious or thee more fortunate.
lines.plainText: Makes me less gracious or thee more fortunate

lines.text: I am as able and as fit as thou
lines.plainText: I am as able and as fit as thou

lines.text: To serve and to deserve my mistress' grace;
lines.plainText: To serve and to deserve my mistress' grace

lines.text: And that my sword upon thee shall approve,
lines.plainText: And that my sword upon thee shall approve

lines.text: And plead my passions for Lavinia's love.
lines.plainText: And plead my passions for Lavinia's love

lines.text: [Aside.] Clubs, clubs! These lovers will not keep the peace.
lines.plainText: Aside Clubs clubs These lovers will not keep the peace

lines.text: Why, boy, although our mother, unadvised,
lines.plainText: Why boy although our mother unadvised

lines.text: Gave you a dancing-rapier by your side,
lines.plainText: Gave you a dancingrapier by your side

lines.text: Are you so desperate grown to threat your friends?
lines.plainText: Are you so desperate grown to threat your friends

lines.text: Go to; have your lath glued within your sheath
lines.plainText: Go to have your lath glued within your sheath

lines.text: Till you know better how to handle it.
lines.plainText: Till you know better how to handle it

lines.text: Meanwhile, sir, with the little skill I have,
lines.plainText: Meanwhile sir with the little skill I have

lines.text: Full well shalt thou perceive how much I dare.
lines.plainText: Full well shalt thou perceive how much I dare

lines.text: Ay, boy, grow ye so brave?
lines.plainText: Ay boy grow ye so brave

lines.text: Why, how now, lords!
lines.plainText: Why how now lords

lines.text: So near the emperor's palace dare ye draw,
lines.plainText: So near the emperor's palace dare ye draw

lines.text: And maintain such a quarrel openly?
lines.plainText: And maintain such a quarrel openly

lines.text: Full well I wot the ground of all this grudge.
lines.plainText: Full well I wot the ground of all this grudge

lines.text: I would not for a million of gold
lines.plainText: I would not for a million of gold

lines.text: The cause were known to them it most concerns;
lines.plainText: The cause were known to them it most concerns

lines.text: Nor would your noble mother for much more
lines.plainText: Nor would your noble mother for much more

lines.text: Be so dishonoured in the court of Rome.
lines.plainText: Be so dishonoured in the court of Rome

lines.text: For shame, put up.
lines.plainText: For shame put up

lines.text: Not I, till I have sheathed
lines.plainText: Not I till I have sheathed

lines.text: My rapier in his bosom, and withal
lines.plainText: My rapier in his bosom and withal

lines.text: Thrust those reproachful speeches down his throat
lines.plainText: Thrust those reproachful speeches down his throat

lines.text: That he hath breathed in my dishonour here.
lines.plainText: That he hath breathed in my dishonour here

lines.text: For that I am prepared and full resolved,
lines.plainText: For that I am prepared and full resolved

lines.text: Foul-spoken coward, that thund'rest with thy tongue,
lines.plainText: Foulspoken coward that thund'rest with thy tongue

lines.text: And with thy weapon nothing dar'st perform.
lines.plainText: And with thy weapon nothing dar'st perform

lines.text: Away, I say!
lines.plainText: Away I say

lines.text: Now, by the gods that warlike Goths adore,
lines.plainText: Now by the gods that warlike Goths adore

lines.text: This pretty brabble will undo us all.
lines.plainText: This pretty brabble will undo us all

lines.text: Why, lords, and think you not how dangerous
lines.plainText: Why lords and think you not how dangerous

lines.text: It is to jet upon a prince's right?
lines.plainText: It is to jet upon a prince's right

lines.text: What, is Lavinia then become so loose,
lines.plainText: What is Lavinia then become so loose

lines.text: Or Bassianus so degenerate,
lines.plainText: Or Bassianus so degenerate

lines.text: That for her love such quarrels may be broached
lines.plainText: That for her love such quarrels may be broached

lines.text: Without controlment, justice, or revenge?
lines.plainText: Without controlment justice or revenge

lines.text: Young lords, beware! And should the empress know
lines.plainText: Young lords beware And should the empress know

lines.text: This discord's ground, the music would not please.
lines.plainText: This discord's ground the music would not please

lines.text: I care not, I, knew she and all the world.
lines.plainText: I care not I knew she and all the world

lines.text: I love Lavinia more than all the world.
lines.plainText: I love Lavinia more than all the world

lines.text: Youngling, learn thou to make some meaner choice.
lines.plainText: Youngling learn thou to make some meaner choice

lines.text: Lavina is thine elder brother's hope.
lines.plainText: Lavina is thine elder brother's hope

lines.text: Why, are ye mad? Or know ye not in Rome
lines.plainText: Why are ye mad Or know ye not in Rome

lines.text: How furious and impatient they be,
lines.plainText: How furious and impatient they be

lines.text: And cannot brook competitors in love?
lines.plainText: And cannot brook competitors in love

lines.text: I tell you, lords, you do but plot your deaths
lines.plainText: I tell you lords you do but plot your deaths

lines.text: By this device.
lines.plainText: By this device

lines.text: Aaron, a thousand deaths
lines.plainText: Aaron a thousand deaths

lines.text: Would I propose to achieve her whom I love.
lines.plainText: Would I propose to achieve her whom I love

lines.text: To achieve her! How?
lines.plainText: To achieve her How

lines.text: Why makes thou it so strange?
lines.plainText: Why makes thou it so strange

lines.text: She is a woman, therefore may be wooed;
lines.plainText: She is a woman therefore may be wooed

lines.text: She is a woman, therefore may be won;
lines.plainText: She is a woman therefore may be won

lines.text: She is Lavinia, therefore must be loved.
lines.plainText: She is Lavinia therefore must be loved

lines.text: What, man, more water glideth by the mill
lines.plainText: What man more water glideth by the mill

lines.text: Than wots the miller of; and easy it is
lines.plainText: Than wots the miller of and easy it is

lines.text: Of a cut loaf to steal a shive, we know.
lines.plainText: Of a cut loaf to steal a shive we know

lines.text: Though Bassianus be the emperor's brother,
lines.plainText: Though Bassianus be the emperor's brother

lines.text: Better than he have worn Vulcan's badge.
lines.plainText: Better than he have worn Vulcan's badge

lines.text: [Aside.] Ay, and as good as Saturninus may.
lines.plainText: Aside Ay and as good as Saturninus may

lines.text: Then why should he despair that knows to court it
lines.plainText: Then why should he despair that knows to court it

lines.text: With words, fair looks, and liberality?
lines.plainText: With words fair looks and liberality

lines.text: What, hast not thou full often struck a doe,
lines.plainText: What hast not thou full often struck a doe

lines.text: And borne her cleanly by the keeper's nose?
lines.plainText: And borne her cleanly by the keeper's nose

lines.text: Why, then, it seems some certain snatch or so
lines.plainText: Why then it seems some certain snatch or so

lines.text: Would serve your turns.
lines.plainText: Would serve your turns

lines.text: Ay, so the turn were served.
lines.plainText: Ay so the turn were served

lines.text: Aaron, thou hast hit it.
lines.plainText: Aaron thou hast hit it

lines.text: Would you had hit it too!
lines.plainText: Would you had hit it too

lines.text: Then should not we be tired with this ado.
lines.plainText: Then should not we be tired with this ado

lines.text: Why, hark ye, hark ye, and are you such fools
lines.plainText: Why hark ye hark ye and are you such fools

lines.text: To square for this? Would it offend you then
lines.plainText: To square for this Would it offend you then

lines.text: That both should speed?
lines.plainText: That both should speed

lines.text: Faith, not me.
lines.plainText: Faith not me

lines.text: Nor me, so I were one.
lines.plainText: Nor me so I were one

lines.text: For shame, be friends, and join for that you jar.
lines.plainText: For shame be friends and join for that you jar

lines.text: 'Tis policy and stratagem must do
lines.plainText: 'Tis policy and stratagem must do

lines.text: That you affect; and so must you resolve
lines.plainText: That you affect and so must you resolve

lines.text: That what you cannot as you would achieve,
lines.plainText: That what you cannot as you would achieve

lines.text: You must perforce accomplish as you may.
lines.plainText: You must perforce accomplish as you may

lines.text: Take this of me: Lucrece was not more chaste
lines.plainText: Take this of me Lucrece was not more chaste

lines.text: Than this Lavinia, Bassianus' love.
lines.plainText: Than this Lavinia Bassianus' love

lines.text: A speedier course than ling'ring languishment
lines.plainText: A speedier course than ling'ring languishment

lines.text: Must we pursue, and I have found the path.
lines.plainText: Must we pursue and I have found the path

lines.text: My lords, a solemn hunting is in hand;
lines.plainText: My lords a solemn hunting is in hand

lines.text: There will the lovely Roman ladies troop.
lines.plainText: There will the lovely Roman ladies troop

lines.text: The forest walks are wide and spacious,
lines.plainText: The forest walks are wide and spacious

lines.text: And many unfrequented plots there are
lines.plainText: And many unfrequented plots there are

lines.text: Fitted by kind for rape and villainy.
lines.plainText: Fitted by kind for rape and villainy

lines.text: Single you thither, then, this dainty doe,
lines.plainText: Single you thither then this dainty doe

lines.text: And strike her home by force, if not by words.
lines.plainText: And strike her home by force if not by words

lines.text: This way, or not at all, stand you in hope.
lines.plainText: This way or not at all stand you in hope

lines.text: Come, come, our empress, with her sacred wit
lines.plainText: Come come our empress with her sacred wit

lines.text: To villainy and vengeance consecrate,
lines.plainText: To villainy and vengeance consecrate

lines.text: Will we acquaint with all what we intend;
lines.plainText: Will we acquaint with all what we intend

lines.text: And she shall file our engines with advice
lines.plainText: And she shall file our engines with advice

lines.text: That will not suffer you to square yourselves,
lines.plainText: That will not suffer you to square yourselves

lines.text: But to your wishes' height advance you both.
lines.plainText: But to your wishes' height advance you both

lines.text: The emperor's court is like the house of Fame,
lines.plainText: The emperor's court is like the house of Fame

lines.text: The palace full of tongues, of eyes and ears;
lines.plainText: The palace full of tongues of eyes and ears

lines.text: The woods are ruthless, dreadful, deaf, and dull.
lines.plainText: The woods are ruthless dreadful deaf and dull

lines.text: There speak and strike, brave boys, and take your turns;
lines.plainText: There speak and strike brave boys and take your turns

lines.text: There serve your lust, shadowed from heaven's eye,
lines.plainText: There serve your lust shadowed from heaven's eye

lines.text: And revel in Lavinia's treasury.
lines.plainText: And revel in Lavinia's treasury

lines.text: Thy counsel, lad, smells of no cowardice.
lines.plainText: Thy counsel lad smells of no cowardice

lines.text: Sit fas aut nefas, till I find the stream
lines.plainText: Sit fas aut nefas till I find the stream

lines.text: To cool this heat, a charm to calm these fits,
lines.plainText: To cool this heat a charm to calm these fits

lines.text: Per Stygia, per manes vehor.
lines.plainText: Per Stygia per manes vehor
